rows.ARS:
Medium red Floribunda.
Registration name: KORvillade
Exhibition name: Rotilia ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Wilhelm Kordes III (1953 - 2016) (Germany, 1992).
Introduced in Germany by W. Kordes' Söhne (Retail) in 2000 as 'Rotilia'.
Introduced in United States by Ashdown Roses Historic Archive in 2007 as 'Rotilia'.
rows.Bloom: Crimson. Moderate, spice fragrance. Average diameter 2". Medium, semi-double (9-16 petals), cluster-flowered, in large clusters bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Small, pointed buds.
rows.Habit:
Medium, bushy, compact, upright. Medium, glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 2' (60cm). Width: 20" (50cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders, container rose, cut flower or garden. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant, very blackspot resistant., very mildew resistant. Remove spent blooms to encourage re-bloom. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
rows.Notes: This variety has been decorated with awards (Gold- and Silver Medal) in international rose competitions.
